facts.fact: Telecompaper reports that Macra's director general Mayamiko Nkoloma, as CRASA chairperson, opened and urged SADC regulators to keep frameworks current at the 46th CRASA executive committee meeting; the outlet gives no meeting date, so the published date 2026-09-16 is used.
